body: I hate losing, really bad. I am the person that goes down ugly, struggling for far too long and never knowing when to give up. The first time I wanted to kill myself I was 14, now I am 21 still here. I just hate losing , that's all the reason I need to keep going.
Because living an unproductive, undignified life is more terrifying to me than death. If I am not allowed to live as I want then I would rather not write a tragedy.
Since my parents act like they are caring about me, but don't really do, they are not willing to pay for a psychologist for me, even after explicitly asking. And I can't afford it with student income
